title: domain.currency_exponent
description: Minor-unit data of a currency (BE-DM-21, BE-DM-22): `exponent` = number of decimal digits kept in amounts, `subunit_to_unit` = minor units per major unit (10^exponent for every currency except MRO, where it is 5), `accepted` = whether the code is in the engine's list of 142 accepted currencies (appendix-currencies.md). For a code outside that list `accepted` is false and `exponent`/`subunit_to_unit` are not graded (the engine never uses them). A string that is not an ISO 4217 code at all is the domain error value_is_invalid on field currency in the reference (no vector grades it).
